description: Be an Earth System Trend Detective! We’re a Ho Chi Minh City team building a tool that turns NASA satellite and model data (MODIS, GPM, MERRA-2) into trends anyone can explore and test for significance. We’re students passionate about climate and data. Join us to turn real Earth data into an immersive experience! We’re looking for teammates skilled in web/app development, data analysis or statistics, web or UI design, and storytelling, or simply curious about our planet.
